final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) as avg_repl_cost, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / rental_duration) as avg_ppd FROM film GROUP BY rating), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ppd) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.avg_repl_cost, step1.avg_ppd, (step1.avg_ppd - step2.overall_avg) as diff FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.avg_ppd > step2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_repl_cost) as avg_replacement_cost, AVG(avg_ppd) as avg_price_per_day, AVG(diff) as avg_difference FROM step3
